item.title: Chenab Valley: Security forces step up vigil to counter terror threat
item.description: Bhaderwah: Braving sub-zero temperatures, the Army and the Special Operations Group (SOG) of Jammu and Kashmir Police have intensified their vigil in the high altitude areas of Chenab valley district to counter any attempt by terrorists to disrupt New Year celebrations, officials said on Wednesday. item.title: Over 3.75 Lakh Ride J&K Vande Bharat in 6 Months

item.title: J&K Gets ₹1,430 crore central boost for disaster mitigation, infra rebuild
item.description: Jammu: In a major relief for Jammu and Kashmir, the Centre has approved over ₹1,430 crore for reconstruction of damaged public infrastructure and disaster mitigation works across the Union Territory, following recommendations of the Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA). item.title: Centre raises excise duty on cigarettes; new rates to take effect from February 1.
item.description: Srinagar,Jan 1: The Finance Ministry has notified a major revision in excise duty on cigarettes and other tobacco products, with the new rates set to come into effect from February 1, 2026. According to the official notification, the government has imposed an additional excise duty on cigarettes ranging from Rs 2,050 to Rs 8,500 per 1,000 sticks. item.title: Leh Freezes at –10.6°C as Sub-Zero Cold Tightens Grip on Kashmir
item.description: Srinagar,Jan 3 : Cold conditions continued across Kashmir and Ladakh on Saturday, with large parts of the Valley recording sub-zero night temperatures, while Ladakh remained in the grip of intense cold, officials said. In Ladakh, temperatures stayed well below the freezing point, with Leh recording a minimum of minus 10.6 degrees Celsius.
